opportunities.title: Regular Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, charitable incorporated organisations (CIOs), and exempt/excepted organisations under Charity Commission guidance. Must have at least one year's worth of annual accounts (independently audited or examined, or a Charity Commission annual return). Cannot fund individuals, CICs, community benefit societies, social enterprises, or local authorities.
opportunities.summary: Open all year round with no deadlines. Grants of under £100,000 towards operating/core costs, capital projects, or projects/specific activities. Operating/core cost grants generally support around 10-20% of an organisation's total annual budget; capital and project grants tend to be 10-20% of total costs, with local community capital projects capped at about £30,000. Decisions within 4-6 months.

opportunities.title: Major Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: For core costs, the organisation's annual income must be £1 million or over. For capital or project costs, the total cost of the project must be at least £1 million (regardless of annual income). Must be an eligible charity (UK registered charity, CIO, or exempt/excepted organisation).
opportunities.summary: Grants of £100,000 and over considered by Trustees at one of eight Board meetings per year. Expression of Interest accepted all year round with no deadlines, reviewed on a rolling basis; successful applicants are invited to submit a full proposal. Supports operating/core costs, capital projects, or projects/specific activities.
